metadata.description: Independent Suno, Seedance, HappyHorse, GPT Image and Nano Banana native Qwen extensions. User-added source, not an official default Qwen directory.

plugins.name: suno-by-ace-data-cloud
plugins.description: Generate Suno music and retrieve completed audio through Ace Data Cloud. Source prerelease: official Qwen native credential fix #14544 is not released; synthetic setup only.

plugins.name: seedance-by-ace-data-cloud
plugins.description: Generate Seedance videos and retrieve the same task through Ace Data Cloud. Source prerelease: official Qwen native credential fix #14544 is not released; synthetic setup only.

plugins.name: happyhorse-by-ace-data-cloud
plugins.description: Generate and edit HappyHorse videos through Ace Data Cloud; retrieve the original task. Source prerelease: official Qwen native credential fix #14544 is not released; synthetic setup only.

plugins.name: gpt-image-by-ace-data-cloud
plugins.description: GPT Image generation, editing and task retrieval through Ace Data Cloud. Dedicated five-tool stdio profile; requires uv/uvx and Python 3.10+. Source RC: official Qwen fix #14544 remains unreleased; synthetic setup only.

plugins.name: nano-banana-by-ace-data-cloud
plugins.description: Generate and edit Nano Banana images through Ace Data Cloud; query the same task for results. Source prerelease: official Qwen native credential fix #14544 is not released; synthetic setup only.
